cases.name: stdin-reader-stop

cases.name: range-fragmentation

cases.name: eof-exit-inversion

cases.name: fd-inheritance

cases.name: digest-mismatch-path-replace

cases.name: exec-failure

cases.name: cancel-deadline-order
cases.acceptance: Deterministic barriers establish first cause before signal/pipe mutation; preserve it through cleanup errors.

cases.name: kill-reap-fault
cases.acceptance: Controlled syscall-result injection separate from real kernel results; unconfirmed cleanup blocks later cases.

cases.name: kernel-policy-denial
cases.acceptance: If memfd/seal/execveat is denied, record rejection and stop. Do not change settings to force success.
